title: Other Narrative Attachments
description: Other narrative files supplied as an ordered list of uploaded attachment references.
notes: The first attachment is mandatory; additional attachments follow it in the same list, as in the existing SGG form.
Examples use synthetic attachment IDs. File ownership and metadata are resolved by the existing application service.
API installation and the authenticated file lifecycle remain separate integration steps; library examples alone are not submission evidence.
No applicant answers are pre- or post-populated. The upload service assigns attachment references when files are uploaded.
Existing-form follow-ups remain open in HHS/simpler-grants-gov: #12483 (boundary/per-file XML) and #11178 (print E2E). Library checks do not close these integration tasks.
